name: Peanuts
description: Peanuts are a potent, high-protein legume that functions nutritionally as an elite oilseed. Packing an exceptional abundance of structural plant proteins, heart-healthy monounsaturated lipids, and critical cellular cofactors like resveratrol and biotin, they serve as a top-tier functional whole food for metabolic stamina, tissue repair, and vascular health.
macroIntro: The macronutrient blueprint of peanuts provides a high-caliber distribution of amino acids and dense lipids, engineered for sustained energy delivery and lean muscular preservation.
microIntro: Peanuts contain a dense crystalline network of B-complex vitamins, antioxidant polyphenols, and foundational trace minerals critical for enzyme activation and genetic repair.

macroNutrients.name: Calories
macroNutrients.description: A robust, highly concentrated biological energy matrix driven by premium plant fats and structural proteins, sustaining prolonged metabolic workflows.

macroNutrients.name: Protein
macroNutrients.description: An exceptionally high protein distribution for a botanical seed, offering rich pools of arginine and essential building blocks for deep cellular tissue repair.

macroNutrients.name: Total Fat
macroNutrients.description: Dominated by oleic acid (monounsaturated) and linoleic acid, providing structural lipids that preserve cellular membrane flexibility and drive fat-soluble absorption.

macroNutrients.name: Carbohydrates
macroNutrients.description: Composed primarily of low-glycemic complex carbohydrates bundled within structural fibers, producing a remarkably flat postprandial glucose signature.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B3 (Niacin)
microNutrients.description: A massive concentration crucial for cellular DNA repair, optimal mitochondrial respiration, and the modulation of systemic lipid transport pathways.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin B7 (Biotin)
microNutrients.description: A primary metabolic coenzyme that aggressively coordinates fatty acid synthesis, gluconeogenesis, and cellular keratin structures.

microNutrients.name: Copper
microNutrients.description: An essential trace catalyst necessary for optimal iron absorption, structural collagen cross-linking, and pristine neural signaling pathways.

microNutrients.name: Magnesium
microNutrients.description: Acts as a key coordinator in over 300 biochemical reactions, regulating neuromuscular relaxation, electrical cardiac tone, and smooth ATP assembly.

microNutrients.name: Vitamin E (Alpha-Tocopherol)
microNutrients.description: A powerful fat-soluble shield that anchors into cellular lipid bilayers, halting the free-radical oxidation of circulating low-density lipoproteins.

microNutrients.name: Resveratrol & Polyphenols
microNutrients.description: Potent non-flavonoid polyphenols identical to those found in red grapes, known to stimulate sirtuin pathways and defend vascular wall elasticity.

healthBenefits: Elite Endothelial & Vascular Protection: High natural distributions of Niacin and the antioxidant *resveratrol* work in synergy to lower systemic inflammatory markers, enhancing localized nitric oxide synthesis for optimal blood vessel dilation.

Robust Amino Acid Muscle Support: Packing more protein than traditional tree nuts, its massive complete amino acid pool supports skeletal tissue regeneration, making it a premier resource for post-exertion muscular preservation.

Mitochondrial Metabolic Synthesis: The extensive concentration of Biotin and Niacin serves as the foundational catalytic spark for cellular fat and carbohydrate oxidation, optimizing daily energy conversion states.

Glycemic and Satiety Regulation: The rich interplay of rigid structural fibers, plant-bound proteins, and healthy monounsaturated fats delays gastric emptying, promoting long-term satiety and preventing sharp insulin responses.
precautionsIntro: Despite their exceptional functional profile, peanuts possess high-reactivity allergen vectors and storage sensitivities that demand strict dietary management parameters.
precautions: Severe IgE-Mediated Allergenic Vectors: Peanuts house highly stable storage proteins (like Ara h 1, 2, and 3) that can trigger immediate, life-threatening anaphylactic immune cascades in hypersensitive profiles. Cross-contamination parameters must be strictly managed.

Fungal Aflatoxin Vulnerability: Because peanuts mature underground, poor industrial harvesting or humid storage conditions can rapidly cultivate *Aspergillus flavus* molds. These produce dangerous aflatoxins, requiring careful sourcing of verified, crisp retail batches.

Anti-Nutrient Phytic Acid Chelation: Raw peanuts carry significant stores of phytic acid, which binds tightly to essential minerals like iron and zinc within the digestive tract. Opting for dry-roasted variants significantly reduces this binding load.

Omega-6 to Omega-3 Structural Imbalances: The lipid architecture of peanuts is heavily weighted toward Omega-6 polyunsaturated fatty acids. Excessive consumption without incorporating clean Omega-3 sources (like fish or flax) can skew systemic inflammatory balance metrics.
